Taxes Committee
Tuesday, May 7th, 2024
09:30 AM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes
Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator Bill
Weber, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Drazkowski, Senator Kari Dziedzic, Senator
Grant Hauschild, Senator Jeremy R. Miller, Senator Aric Putnam

Excused: Senator Carla J. Nelson

Senator Ann H. Rest called the meeting to order at 9:39 a.m.

Approval of the minutes from 5/2/24.

The minutes were approved as presented.

S.F. 4985: Senator Westlin: Tax Forfeited Lands Policy Changes

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4985 be taken from the table. MOTION PREVAILED.

Senator Klein moved that S.F. 4985 be recommended to pass and referred to the Finance
Committee. MOTION PREVAILED.

S.F. 3886: Senator Hauschild: Onetime Aid Program for Certain Licensed Ambulance
Services Establishment Appropriation

Senator Hauschild moved that S.F. 3886 be taken from the table. MOTION PREVAILED.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-5 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Senator Hauschild moved that S.F. 3886, as amended be recommended to pass and referred
to the Finance Committee. MOTION PREVAILED.

The meeting was adjourned at 10:02 a.m.
